evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-709 ARC-108 x ARC-110 LEARNED (dopamine-gated) CROSS-LOOP ARBITRATION VALIDATION (experiment_purpose=evidence; claim_ids=[MECH-439, ARC-108, ARC-110]). The SEPARATE new-EXQ falsifier the V3-EXQ-707b autopsy (item 3) routed: a DIFFERENT mechanism from the 700/707 lineage. 707b built ARC-110 loop segregation FULLY LIVE (all 6 non-degeneracy gates passed, limbic range 1.414) but the limbic loop NEVER won -- committed-class entropy A1_LOOPS 0.838 ~ A0_SINGLE_ARENA 0.914; the autopsy traced it to the STATIC ARITHMETIC cross-loop combine (fixed spiral gains cannot LEARN). The substrate landed 2026-07-01 (ree-v3 main 832afd1) replaces it with a LEARNED [3,3] cross-loop matrix W_cross = I + M_cross updated by the ARC-108 signed-RPE three-factor rule (shared delta_t / V-hat / D1-D2 asym), coupled with MECH-450 settling; M_cross[motor,limbic] is the plastic ascending-spiral path. 2 arms on the SAME GAP-A reef-bipartite foraging substrate + the SAME matched envelope (finer gating + learned settling + named-channel routing + limbic input modules); the ONLY swept factor is use_learned_cross_loop_arbitration: A1_LOOPS_STATIC (OFF -- the 707b static-arithmetic control) vs A1_LOOPS_LEARNED (ON). At init M_cross==0 -> W_cross==I -> the arms are bit-identical; they diverge only as M_cross learns (verified live via the (W) weights-moved gate). PRE-REGISTERED decisive: C1 = A1_LOOPS_LEARNED committed-class entropy strict-above A1_LOOPS_STATIC + margin on a strict-majority (>=2/3) of divergent seeds. PASS => learned arbitration LIFTS the F-dominance conversion ceiling where static could not -> MECH-439 weakens (ceiling liftable) / ARC-108 supports (learned gating converts) / ARC-110 supports (loops load-bearing once arbitration learns; resolves the 707b necessary-but-not-sufficient release condition). FAIL (decisive) => even learned arbitration cannot convert -> MECH-439 supports (ceiling INTRINSIC) / ARC-108 + ARC-110 weakens. Non-vacuity self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory, non_degenerate=False, NEVER a false weakens) when the learned M_cross weights did NOT move off init (LEARNED == STATIC) OR the limbic loop can NEVER reach the motor loop's effective weight OR the 707b liveness preconditions fail (loops not live / limbic routing inert / learning not engaged). PROMOTES NOTHING (MECH-439 candidate/substrate_ceiling; ARC-108/ARC-110 candidate/substrate_conditional/v3). outcome=FAIL; label=substrate_not_ready_requeue; per_claim={'MECH-439': 'non_contributory', 'ARC-108': 'non_contributory', 'ARC-110': 'non_contributory'}.

interpretation_grid.PASS_learned_cross_loop_arbitration_lift: preconditions met (divergent seeds + loops carry LIVE cross-loop variance + named-channel routing live + the learned M_cross weights MOVED off init + the limbic loop CAN win + learning engaged) AND C1 (A1_LOOPS_LEARNED committed-class entropy strict-above A1_LOOPS_STATIC + margin on a strict-majority of divergent seeds). Learned DA-gated cross-loop arbitration CONVERTS committed-action diversity where the STATIC arbitration (707b) plateaued -> the F-dominance conversion ceiling is LIFTABLE (weakens MECH-439), via ARC-108 learned gating applied at the ARC-110 cross-loop arbitration (supports both). First evidence that learned arbitration lifts the ceiling where static could not.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_learned_cross_loop_arbitration_does: DECISIVE. preconditions met (the learned M_cross MOVED, the limbic loop COULD win, loops live) BUT A1_LOOPS_LEARNED does NOT lift committed-class entropy strict-above A1_LOOPS_STATIC. Even learned DA-gated cross-loop arbitration cannot convert -> the F-dominance conversion ceiling is INTRINSIC (supports MECH-439); the ARC-108 x ARC-110 learned-arbitration route does not deliver (weakens both).
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: A precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds, OR the loops carry NO live cross-loop variance, OR the NAMED limbic channels carry NO routed per-candidate range (MECH-191 phasic gap -- limbic loop inert), OR the learned M_cross weights did NOT move off init (LEARNED bit-identical to STATIC -- no-lift meaningless), OR the limbic loop can NEVER reach the motor loop's effective weight, OR learning was not engaged / CRF not matured. The conversion question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification.
